{{Top}}
{{Quote|I'm going to have to shoot them all in the head before they try to eat my liver.|Ryamn, about his patients infected with the rakghoul plague|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''liver''' was an edible internal organ found in many [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures and [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. While a type of food that [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] did not like,<ref name="SWK6">[[Star Wars Kids (1997) 6|''Star Wars Kids'' (1997) 6]]</ref> [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] ate Human livers,<ref name="Prisoner of the Nikto Pirates">''[[Star Wars Missions 13: Prisoner of the Nikto Pirates]]''</ref> and many species enjoyed the livers of other creatures.<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> The liver was one of the primary organs for processing [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]],<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref> but heavy doses of alcoholic substances could damage it.<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> If the liver failed completely, one could [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="Republic Commando: Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> Fortunately for those with liver trouble, livers could be cloned,<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter" /> grafted,<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> and genetically enhanced.<ref name="Slave Ship" />

[[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]]<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> and [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltrons]]<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> were examples of sentient humanoids who had two livers, which allowed them to enjoy a larger number of alcoholic beverages than other humanoids.
